# Mac Hancom image-editing reference captures

These six small fixtures were generated by Rau, opened in Mac Hancom 12.30.0 build 6446, and exported through `파일 > PDF로 저장하기...` on 2026-09-05. Each PDF was rendered and visually inspected. The input HWPX files were not resaved or edited in Hancom.

`capture.json` records source and PDF hashes, the edit recipes, application and OS versions, export settings and the bundled font file hash. `initial-comparison.json` preserves the measured differences before the table-margin correction.

Mac Hancom's PDF export uses Quartz. Its producer is `macOS 버전 26.4(빌드 25E246) Quartz PDFContext`, not the Windows Hancom producer signature. Provenance here comes from observing the Hancom export and recording the exact input/output hashes. Quartz metadata alone is not evidence of Hancom provenance.

This set checks how Hancom opens Rau's exported documents. Independently reproducing each edit from `source.hwpx` in Hancom is still pending. Do not describe these files as independently authored editing oracles or proof of full formatting parity.

Compare a new diagnostic rendering with these references:

```sh
uv run --with pymupdf python rhwp/tools/editing_parity/compare_diagnostic_exports.py \
  rhwp/output/editing-parity/NEW_RUN \
  --reference-directory rhwp/tests/fixtures/editing_parity/mac-hancom-12.30.0
```

The comparator refuses reference reuse when `edited.hwpx` bytes differ. It currently compares page counts, non-whitespace line breaks, line-start/baseline positions and single-image bounds. It does not check every glyph or whitespace position, table border or page feature. Even a passing result is limited to these checks.

For a read-only rendering of these exact inputs under the Mac HCR font policy, run from `rhwp`:

```sh
cargo run --example editing_parity_fixtures --no-default-features -- \
  output/editing-parity/NEW_INPUT_RENDER --hcr-declared \
  --reference-inputs=tests/fixtures/editing_parity/mac-hancom-12.30.0
```

The current exact-input comparison has two limited passes and four failures. Newly generated editing recipes have corrected cell wrapping but changed line-break data. They receive `reference-input-changed` against this original set. The separate [XML 1.4 capture set](../mac-hancom-12.30.0-xml14/README.md) now covers those corrected inputs and has five limited passes and one first-cell-spacing failure.

`cargo test --test editing_parity_hancom_image_bounds --no-default-features`, run from `rhwp`, checks the measured image bounds for the empty, mixed-text and full-width cells through three reopen cycles. It does not suppress or replace the known text-wrapping failures reported by the comparator.

Do not replace the captures or update their hashes to make a test pass. Add a reviewed reference set when new documents or capture settings are needed.
